{{Quote|Always knew he'd pick the fight that'd cost him.|Torian Cadera|<ref name="Mission" />}}
'''Jogo''', also known as '''Jogo the Carver''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Bralor/Legends|Clan Bralor]] who was the son of [[Salus Bralor]]. A hunter during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jogo was one of a number of Mandalorians who tested themselves against [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Hunter (individual)|most recent Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] after Jogo angered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]; Jogo believed, incorrectly, that the hunter would be unable to kill the Sithspawn [[Akure]], and the hunter killed Jogo after successfully slaying the beast.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
If Jogo is slain by the player, his father Salus Bralor confronts the player after the end of their storyline on Taris.<ref name="Mission" />
